objective: Prove E1; search the excursion components of the 15 genus-2 floor states for k = 2, 4, 6 and unbounded (E2, E3).
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (E1 by hand; the search computed; pre-registered): at the genus-2 floor a fixed-state learner has no step; with the law fixed and state flips allowed one unit above the floor without limit, the unit never leaves its atom (exhaustive on five K_2 components, the same to a cap of 200,000 states elsewhere). E2 and E3 failed.
title: Excursions out of an atom
